Container.Name: listening-dungeon
Container.Overview:
The Listening Dungeon: every audiobook your players finish in Audiobookshelf becomes a dungeon to crawl. Classes, gear, loot, an Arena, a December party boss, plus Tier Lists, Recommendations, Release Radar and book Requests.
Install listening-dungeon-abs-stats first: this container gets everything through it.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port you open the game on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The game's database, covers and settings. Back this up.

Config.Name: abs-stats address
Config.Description: Where this container reaches abs-stats. On the default bridge network use your server's IP and abs-stats' port. On a custom Docker network shared by both containers you can use http://listening-dungeon-abs-stats:3000.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for /admin (monsters, loot, requests, Release Radar). Required: pick your own.

Config.Name: Admin session key
Config.Description: Any long random text (40+ characters). Keeps admin logins working across restarts.

Config.Name: Players
Config.Description: Comma-separated Audiobookshelf usernames who can play. Leave empty for every ABS user.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Your timezone. The Store restocks at midnight and the December boss's weeks follow it.

Config.Name: Release Radar check (hours)
Config.Description: How often Release Radar checks Audible for new books in your series.
